headlines.title: Trump eases Russia sanctions, says Putin will release diesel amid massive price spike
headlines.description: President Donald Trump said Russian President Vladimir Putin would “immediately” release hundreds of thousands of tons of diesel fuel onto the global market.

headlines.title: Florida and Alabama declare states of emergency as Hurricane Isaias nears Gulf Coast
headlines.description: Hurricane Isaias is now a major Category 3 storm, with the National Hurricane Center warning of life-threatening storm surge and devastating winds. NBC News meteorologist Bill Karins breaks down the latest forecast, while Chris Pollone reports from Alabama on the preparations underway as residents brace for impact.

headlines.title: Food pantries overwhelmed by Trump cuts
headlines.description: Those on the front lines of feeding their neighbors in rural West Virginia say they face unprecedented challenges brought on by Washington.

headlines.title: Early vote analysis: Mail ballot concerns are changing how Democrats vote
headlines.description: Democrats are changing how they vote, requesting fewer mail ballots than in past elections but returning the ones they do request more quickly, according to a new NBC News Decision Desk analysis of the early vote conducted in coordination with the University of Pennsylvania.

headlines.title: With all eyes on Texas Senate race, James Talarico has vanished from the campaign trail
headlines.description: In final stretch of the Texas Senate race, Talarico has not appeared in person since Sept. 26; he is expected to be back this weekend.

headlines.title: Remembering Mike Ditka's life and legacy
headlines.description: NBC News' Sam Brock looks back at the career, accomplishments and championship legacy of legendary Chicago Bears coach and Hall of Fame player Mike Ditka.

headlines.title: Vance suggests Nidal Hasan’s execution won’t be livestreamed, contradicting Hegseth
headlines.description: Vice President JD Vance suggested the federal government wouldn’t livestream the execution of Fort Hood shooter Nidal Hasan, contradicting Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth.

headlines.title: Katie Zacharia will be the next White House press secretary
headlines.description: Conservative commentator Katie Zacharia is expected to be named the next White House press secretary, replacing Karoline Leavitt.

headlines.title: Trump establishes panel to probe Fed governor Lisa Cook in latest attempt to fire her
headlines.description: President Donald Trump established a committee to investigate Fed governor Lisa Cook, in his latest attempt to fire her.

headlines.title: Man Shot in Car by ICE in New York as 5-Year-Old Sat in Backseat
headlines.description: Outrage and intense protests erupted in New York after ICE agents opened fire on a 28-year-old man in a car with a 5-year-old child in the backseat. The Department of Homeland Security says it was part of a “targeted enforcement operation” and said in a statement they were seeking an “illegal alien from the Dominican Republic” who has a criminal history. NBC’s Erin McLaughlin reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: The secret to a good night’s rest? Let sleeping dogs lie — next to you
headlines.description: A surprising new study found that people who sleep near their dogs don’t experience disrupted sleep. If anything we humans are the ones disturbing our dogs’ sleep.

headlines.title: They were a historically bad team. Now they’re a threat to make the World Series.
headlines.description: The Chicago White Sox are up 2-0 in the American League Division Series, a shocking turnaround after three straight 100-loss seasons.
